text:
Type: round low-pile rug
Use: defining a seating, reading or play area; living room, bedroom, children's room
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, modern
Materials: short dense cut pile, bound edge in navy fabric
Colors: dark navy blue, off-white, navy edge
Shape: circle covered in irregular hand-drawn dots, navy binding around the edge, flat and soft, medium size, graphic pattern
Feel: playful, fresh, lively
Goes with: white walls, light wood, blue or grey textiles; Scandinavian, coastal or modern living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: FLNG
product.description: The thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
